title: 第11章 养身拳第12章 先天功
content_zh:
“说，还要不要田家大小姐的身份？”田中明一脸怒气的问道。
“没有不要。”田于微低着头，眼里还是非常的不甘，但她也不敢再多说。
“你做的这些事，要是让外人知道，被李希发现，我们田家就完了，我再给你一次机会，以后你再做出这种事来，你就在田家消失，明白了吗？”
田于微一听，哪怕心里再不甘也不敢再违逆父亲，她低声说道：“好，女儿明白了，父亲别气，以后我再也不会了。”
田中明一脸失望的看着女儿，他心里叹了一口气说道：“回去给我禁足，好好的练功，先天功不练到五层，就别想再出去了。”
人心真的是可怕啊！
易长生终于知道田家大小姐为什么要抓那些孤儿了，也由心的感受到人性的恐怖之处。
他看着田家大小姐回到小院，在书房里拳打脚踢对着空气愤怒又无声的呐喊，狰狞的表情阴狠的眼神，真的很可怕。
不过从他们的谈话的信息得知，没有灵根就不能修仙。
易长生看了一眼面板上自己的灵根信息，自己应该是有灵根的吧，六灵根应该也是有灵根吧？
易长生摇了一下头没再多想，看到前面有一家书铺，就转进书铺里。
伙计见是一个小童进来就问道：“小客官需要买些什么？”
“我先看看。”易长生扫了一眼柜台里的那些文房四宝。
问了一下价格，就选了一套便宜的，然后又买了几本记事本，几刀纸，看了一眼书柜上的书，他又选了几本陈国的风物志，凤鸣州的风物志，还有几本游记。
结了账，他就回到了西街，买了肉米面蛋，还有一些能保存久点的蔬菜，像萝卜、大白菜之类的。
买完这些东西，篮子已经装满了，他转回小巷子里，小心留意着有没有尾随，一路安全的回到偏僻的宅院后门，再次确定没有人后快速地进门，关紧门闩。
易长生打量了一下院子，没发现有人来过的痕迹，就直接进了书房。
他打开地下室，把篮子放在地下室里，又上到院子里打了两桶水拿到地下室，又从东厢房里搬了两张椅子下到地下室，把地下室的机关关上，他才松了一口气。
还是在没有人的地方才让他觉得放松。
有人的地方，不管是身体还是精神，他都是一直紧绷着。

休息了一会，易长生看了一眼田大小姐，发现她还在发疯，便收拾着篮子里买回来的东西，特别是文房四宝纸张这些脆弱的东西。
他把文房四宝和一些空白的记事本放在箱子上面，拿着椅子放在旁边，随时准备抄书。
从田家父女两人的对话中，易长生就知道《先天功》是那个李希给他们的。
而以李希修仙者的身份，从他指缝里流出来的东西，都是好东西啊！
易长生就等着田家大小姐将功法拿出来看了，只要知道是哪本书，他就有机会将先天功抄出来。
嗯，其他的书籍要是不错的话也可以抄一下。
他准备好后，田大小姐已经不再发疯了，但可能是累了就直接在坐在地上一动不动的发呆。
易长生算了一下时间，快到中午了，他就拿着食物到地道下面去做饭吃。
养了几天，他的身体好了很多，但还是瘦弱，还是要好好的补才能将身体养回来。
养身汤就是温和的补药，等吃完饭后，他就开始熬养身汤。
content_en:
"Tell me, do you still want the identity of the eldest lady of the Tian family?" Tian Zhongming asked angrily.
"No, no." Tian Yuwei lowered her head, her eyes still very unwilling, but she did not dare to say any more.
"If these things you have done are known to outsiders and discovered by Li Xi, our Tian family will be finished. I will give you another chance. If you do such a thing again in the future, you will disappear from the Tian family. Do you understand?"
When Tian Yuwei heard this, she did not dare to disobey her father no matter how unwilling she was. She whispered: "Okay, my daughter understands. Don't be angry, father. I will never do it again in the future."
Tian Zhongming looked at his daughter with a disappointed look on his face. He sighed inwardly and said, "Go back and ground me, and practice your martial arts well. If you don't practice your innate martial arts to the fifth level, don't even think about going out again."
The human heart is really terrible!
Yi Changsheng finally understood why the eldest daughter of the Tian family wanted to arrest those orphans, and he also felt the horror of human nature.
He watched the eldest daughter of the Tian family return to the small courtyard, punching and kicking her in the study, screaming angrily and silently into the air, with a ferocious expression and sinister eyes, it was really scary.
However, from the information in their conversation, we learned that one cannot cultivate immortality without spiritual roots.
Yi Changsheng glanced at his spiritual root information on the panel. He should have spiritual roots. The six spiritual roots should also have spiritual roots, right?
Yi Changsheng shook his head and didn't think much more. When he saw a bookstore in front of him, he turned into the bookstore.
When the waiter saw a child coming in, he asked, "What does the young guest need to buy?"
"Let me take a look first." Yi Changsheng glanced at the Four Treasures of the Study on the counter.
After asking about the price, he chose a cheap set, and then bought a few notepads and some paper. After looking at the books on the bookcase, he selected a few more books about the scenery of Chen State, a history of Fengming Prefecture, and a few travel notes.
After paying the bill, he returned to West Street and bought meat, rice, noodles and eggs, as well as some vegetables that could be kept longer, such as radishes and Chinese cabbage.
After buying these things and the basket was full, he turned back to the alley, carefully watching for anyone following him, and safely returned to the back door of the remote house. After confirming again that no one was there, he quickly entered the door and closed the door bolt tightly.
Yi Changsheng looked around the yard and found no trace of anyone coming, so he went directly into the study.
He opened the basement, put the basket in the basement, went up to the yard and fetched two buckets of water and brought them to the basement. He also moved two chairs from the east wing and went down to the basement. He closed the basement's mechanism and he breathed a sigh of relief.
He felt relaxed when he was in a place with no people.
Wherever there are people, he is always tense, whether physically or mentally.
After resting for a while, Yi Changsheng glanced at Miss Tian and found that she was still going crazy, so he packed the things he bought in the basket, especially fragile things like the Four Treasures of the Study paper.
He put the Four Treasures of the Study and some blank notepads on top of the box, and put a chair next to it, ready to copy books at any time.
From the conversation between Tian's father and daughter, Yi Changsheng knew that "Xiantian Gong" was given to them by Li Xi.
And as Li Xi is an immortal cultivator, the things that flow out from his fingers are all good things!
Yi Changsheng was waiting for the eldest daughter of the Tian family to take out the skills and read them. As long as he knew which book it was, he would have a chance to copy the innate skills.
Well, you can also copy other books if they are good.
After he was ready, Miss Tian was no longer crazy, but maybe she was tired and just sat on the ground motionless in a daze.
Yi Changsheng calculated the time and found that it was almost noon, so he took the food and went down into the tunnel to cook.
After a few days of nursing, his body has improved a lot, but he is still thin, and he still needs to take good supplements to regain his health.
The health-preserving soup is a mild tonic. After finishing the meal, he started to make the health-preserving soup.
